India: Delhi surpasses Lahore as world's most polluted city
November 14, 2026
Delhi's Air Quality Index (AQI) was recorded to be higher than Lahore in Pakistan on Friday, which made it the most polluted city globally.
What you need to know
- SwissIQ reported Delhi AQI at 334, categorizing it as "hazardous" on Friday
- In Assam, at least 23 people died after a truck and bus collided
Here is a roundup of headlines from India on Saturday, November 14:
Delhi overtakes Lahore as world's most polluted city
On Friday, Delhi's Air Quality Index (AQI) stood at 334, categorized as "hazardous"making it the most polluted major city globally, according to Swiss air quality monitoring group IQAir.
The Indian capital's AQI was recorded to be higher than Lahore in Pakistan on Friday, which made it the most polluted city globally.
Quoting IQAir's hourly data, Pakistani newspaper Dawn reported that on Friday Delhi's AQI had dropped to 208 at 11.30 a.m. local time (0630 UTC). At the time, Lahore was ranked seventh among the world’s most polluted major cities, with an AQI of 155.
India's official Central Pollution Control Board, however, recorded the AQI higher at 403 and rated it "severe."
The difference between the Indian and Swiss readings is caused by the fact that the two use different AQI scales and methodologies to calculate and categorize air pollution levels.
Visibility in Delhi is significantly impacted as a thick layer of smog has enveloped the city.
In many parts of northern India and Pakistan, pollution poses a seasonal problem as the cold, heavy air of winter traps vehicle emissions, construction dust and smoke from agricultural burning.
Welcome to our coverage
Hello! This is Midhat from DW's New Delhi Bureau bringing you all that's creating a buzz in India over the weekend.
With festivities over now, what's left for Delhi and the northern belt is the pollution to deal with. The Indian capital overtook Lahore in Pakistan to become the most polluted city in the world on Friday.
Meanwhile, a deadly truck-bus collision in India's northeastern state of Assam, which has claimed at least 23 lives, has shaken the region.
Stay tuned as we bring you more news from India over the course of the day.

ביום שישי האחרון עקפה הבירה ההודית דלהי את לאהור שבפקיסטן והפכה לעיר המזוהמת ביותר בעולם, לאחר שמדד איכות האוויר בה נרשם ברמה המסוכנת. קבוצת המעקב הבינלאומית IQAir דיווחה כי מדד איכות האוויר בדלהי עמד על 334 והוגדר כמסוכן, בעוד שמועצת בקרת זיהום האוויר הרשמית של הודו רשמה מדד גבוה אף יותר של 403 ודירגה אותו כחמור.

ההבדלים בין הנתונים נובעים משימוש בסולמות מדידה שונים. תושבי האזור סובלים מהשפעות קשות של ערפיח המצמצם את הראות, בע탁 ששילוב של מזג אוויר חורפי קריר, פליטות כלי רכב, אבק בנייה ושריפות חקלאיות ממשיך להחמיר את הבעיות הסביבתיות בצפון הודו ובפקיסטן בעונת החורף.
